meta.title: Covelet · A private start page you can verify, that doesn’t go soft
hero.h1: A private start page you can verify, that doesn’t go soft
hero.tagline: No account · Encrypted on device · Data stays in storage you control
hero.lead: Covelet is a Chrome / Edge new-tab extension. Nav and notes are encrypted on your device with AES. Across devices, sync to your own WebDAV (Nutstore or Nextcloud). There is no Covelet product server, and we don’t proxy ciphertext.
points.no_account: No account to create. We don’t proxy OAuth either.
points.local_aes: Nav and notes are encrypted on your device. You can see permissions and where data lives in the extension.
points.own_storage: Cloud sync today is WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). The rest are still Beta.
points.no_telemetry: No ads, no third-party analytics, no usage stats in the extension. It will never add PostHog.
verify.body: This page only explains the product. It never touches your nav or notes. The extension has zero telemetry and no PostHog. This site may count visits with cookieless Cloudflare Web Analytics, on this site only, never in the extension, not tied to who you are. In the extension you can run a “Privacy checkup,” shipping with 0.2.2.
site_wont.body: There’s no login here, and we don’t collect emails. Your start page never becomes ad space. If we count visits, it’s only cookieless Cloudflare Web Analytics on this site. The page explains the product and links to the store.
storage.intro: Cloud sync today is WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). The rest are still Beta.
storage.step1: Prefer WebDAV (Nutstore / Nextcloud). The rest are Beta.
storage.step2: Enter only what the connection needs, then test it.
storage.step3_title: Set a sync password and sync once
storage.step3: Other devices use the same target and sync password.
storage.note: Saving is not the same as verified. Trust a successful connection test. If the test fails, you can stay local-only; local data is untouched. On multi-device conflicts you keep one whole record or the other. Nothing merges silently.
migrate.bookmarks: Coming soon. Runs on your device; works with bookmark files exported from the browser.
migrate.others: Migration paths are still under review.
close.h2: Keep the new tab for yourself
close.body: No preset promo sites. After install you start from an empty desktop and add the sites you use.
